nameEn: Treatment and coating of metals; machining
description: This class includes the treatment and coating of metals and the general machining of metal parts.
includes: deburring, sandblasting, tumbling, cleaning of metals
non-permanent protection of metals: oiling, greasing, rust-proofing
general machining operations on metal: turning, boring, milling, eroding, planing, lapping, broaching, levelling, sawing, grinding, sharpening, polishing, welding
excludes: manufacture of metal hand tools, see 2593
